note: The day Moses struck the rock at Horeb and water for the people came from it (according to tradition, see Exodus 17:1–7). The memorial of Count Von Zinzendorf (of blessed memory), a Christian Zionist and Messianic pioneer who died in 1760 CE (5520). Zinzendorf was a famous Christian leader who had a vision for the national and spiritual restoration of Israel to her Land. With that goal, he encouraged the start of communities of Torah-faithful, Jewish disciples in several countries. Day 38 of the Omer
prompts: What verse spoke to you most today and why?
Did you learn something about God?
